template.name: Multi Stochastic
template.entry_long: donchian_high(high,{p0}) - donchian_low(low,{p1}) > {p0} and crossabove(sma({p1} * (close - donchian_low(low,{p2})) / (donchian_high(high,5) - donchian_low(low,5)),3), 20)
template.exit_long: donchian_high(high,5) - donchian_low(low,5) > 0 and crossbelow(sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,5)) / (donchian_high(high,5) - donchian_low(low,5)),3), 80)
template.notes: StochasticLength=5 with the documented 3/3 %K smoothing is exact, guarded against a zero range, so the oversold crossover of OversoldLevel=20 opens the long and the overbought crossover of OverboughtLevel=80 closes it. StopLossPips=50 and TakeProfitPips=10 are pip distances, not percents, so both fields are null, and the extra currency pairs and per-slot toggles are unavailable.
